t: The Nebo Luxtreme Nano rechargeable LED flashlight delivers powerful and portable illumination for a variety of tasks. With 420 lumens and an impressive 300m beam distance, this ultra-compact torch is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general trade professionals requiring reliable work light in challenging environments. Its durable aluminium body is impact-resistant, ensuring longevity on site. Featuring convenient USB-C charging and an integrated Li-Ion battery, it provides up to 8 hours of run time. Smart Power Control seamlessly transitions through five light modes, including High, Low, Strobe, and Boost, while an IPX6 water-resistant rating offers robust performance indoors and outdoors.
